learningObjective: Distinguish XLA fusion kinds (loop / input / output) and understand their boundaries.

canonicalClaims.claim: XLA implements multiple fusion kinds (loop, input, output, custom), each aligned with a memory-access pattern between producer and consumer; the pass is guided by a cost model and has boundaries (register/SMEM pressure, opaque calls, layout mismatches).
nonImplications: Does not imply fusion is unconditional.
Does not imply fusion is GPU-only.

misconceptions.claim: XLA fuses every adjacent HLO op pair unconditionally.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Fusion has cost heuristics and hard boundaries.

misconceptions.claim: Fusion is textual duplication of producer into consumer.
misconceptions.whyWrong: Fusion is an HLO `fusion` op with a nested computation.
Output/epilogue fusion routinely merges elementwise stages into reductions.
Register pressure and SMEM constraints can make over-fusion slower.

implementationFacts: HLO `fusion` op carries a nested computation with the fused body.
Fusion kinds are attributes on the fusion op (loop/input/output/custom).
